note: core_facts and cases are copied VERBATIM from the archived runner, INCLUDING relevant/language/category. scripts/benchmark-retrieval-h2h.ts --self-test re-checks every statement, query, language, category and relevant array against that archived source, so this file cannot drift from the ground truth it claims. distractor_facts are authored by the harness author, are ingested identically by every system under test, and never appear in any case.relevant list.
authorship_warning: 30 of the 38 corpus facts (all distractor_facts) were authored by the harness author after reading Titen's ranker. This is a disclosed bias vector, not a neutral corpus. A neutral lane needs an externally authored fixture; see the header of scripts/benchmark-retrieval-h2h.ts for how to build and run one (Mr. TyDi Indonesian, CC-BY-SA-3.0), which this repository deliberately does not vendor.
v2_changes: Added 8 distractors, one per case, each sharing the gold's rarest content term so no case is a lexical walkover. Corpus 30 -> 38.
scored_content: fixture_version, top_k, core_facts, distractor_facts, cases and ground_truth_variants are the only fields that can move a published number. scripts/benchmark-retrieval-h2h.ts asserts a pinned sha256 over exactly those fields; prose fields above may be edited freely.

strict.description: the archived runner's ground truth, unmodified. `cases[].relevant` IS this variant.

lenient.description: independent re-judge of every case. id_semantic_rollback is under-annotated: fact_orion_requirement is a rollback procedure executed before activation and answers 'safe procedure to reverse a deployment before users are affected'. Every other case was independently confirmed. Publish both variants or neither.

discriminating_queries.note: id_no_result_passport is a tie by construction. At the primary threshold 0.0 a system that always returns something scores 0, so the case only moves under --threshold, and a score threshold is not comparable across systems whose score scales differ.
